newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa loses impetus, may test support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa loses impetus, may test support.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa looks to have lost momentum, although there is no reason why it should not go higher, technical analysts said on Monday.
They were thinking more in terms of a test of support than a challenge to the apparently weak resistance above the market.
Traders called cocoa to open around three sterling higher.
"There's no reason why it shouldn't go higher," independent analyst Elli Gifford said. But while there was hardly any resistance above themarket, the rally appeared to be running out of steam.
There was some support at around 1,005 stg a tonne but the real support was at 1,000 stg. A dip to that level might trigger selling.

Sterling's drop against other European currencies last week gave cash cocoa buyers an advantage, but dwindling supplies from major origins such as Ivory Coast kept business at a minimum, traders said. Holidays in several countries kept business at the end of the week quiet.
